verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਨ ਧਨੁਖ ਸਹਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਨਿਜ ਬਸ ਛੂਟਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਤਨ ਸੈ ਹਾਥ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise baan dhanukh sahit hui nij bas chhooTat na aavai fun jatan sai haath jee ||

en.bdb: Just as an arrow is in full control (of the warrior) as long as it remains in the bow, but once released cannot come back howsoever one may try.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਾਘ ਬੰਦਸਾਲਾ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਾਂਧਿੳੋ ਰਹੈ ਪੁਨਿ ਖੁਲੈ ਤਉ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਸਿ ਬਸਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਥ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise baagh ba(n)dhasaalaa bikhai baa(n)dhiuo rahai pun khulai tau na aavai bas baseh na saath jee ||

en.bdb: Just as a lion remains in a cage, but when released cannot be brought under control. Once out of control, it cannot be tamed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਪ ਦਿਪਤ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਭਵਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਦਾਵਾਨਲ ਭਏ ਨ ਦੁਰਾਏ ਦੁਰੈ ਨਾਥ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise dheep dhipat na jaaneeaai bhavan bikhai dhaavaanal bhe na dhuraae dhurai naath jee ||

en.bdb: Just as the heat of a lit lamp is not felt by anybody in the house, but if it becomes the fire of the jungle (spreads in the house) then it becomes uncontrollable.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਮੁਖ ਮਧ ਬਾਣੀ ਬਸਤ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਖੈ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਥ ਜੀ ॥੬੩੦॥
verses.translit_en: taise mukh madh baanee basat na kouoo lakhai boleeaai bichaar gurmat gun gaath jee ||630||

en.bdb: Similarly, like an arrow released from the bow, words spoken cannot be taken back. Therefore one should always think and reflect on what one is about to say and all conversation should be in accordance with the wisdom bestowed by the Guru. (630)
